finalText:
Migration finished. 12 files still on `db.query` — 36 call sites — now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js`, `src/service/teamService.js`, `src/admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`
- `packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js`, `src/service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js`, `src/admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js`, `src/service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support/src/repo/sla.js`, `src/admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

The rewrite matches the shape already used by the migrated files (e.g. `invoice.js`). All package files pass `node --check`.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

1. **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** still has two `db.query` calls. Its header says the vendored copy is replaced wholesale on upgrade and local edits are silently lost, so patching it there would be undone. Since `db.query` is slated for removal in the driver's next major, this needs a real fix — upstream patch, a pinned fork, or a small local wrapper around the adapter. Your call; say the word and I'll do it anyway.
2. **`cache.query(...)`** in the `cached*` helpers is the cache client, a different API — untouched.
